sentences.text: Researchers analyzed data from 325 patients who had brain metastases removed surgically, finding that about one-third of this group experienced seizures.
Among these individuals, those who had seizures when their disease first started lived longer than those who did not.
The authors caution that these results are preliminary and need to be checked in bigger groups of patients.
